skip.only-lazy-folding-demotes-a-marker-line-: Measured against the bundled TextMate grammar: the two files produce 4 distinct scopes and every one is already pinned by a covered corpus snapshot or a committed fixture. What the category rules on is a decision a line-based grammar structurally cannot make: in the `-2` variant a lazy line on the next row demotes the opener to literal text, and the grammar has already scoped it as a div by then and cannot take that back.
